description: Export ONE sequence as an editing file for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut, so the cut can be finished there. Costs nothing. fcpxml (recommended for Resolve): V1 as the main storyline with gaps, the sequence's transitions as centered cross dissolves (dropped where the next clip has no head or at a gap), audio stems and V2+ as connected clips. otio: OpenTimelineIO JSON (video and gaps, speed; no audio, no transitions). edl: CMX 3600 (video plus up to 4 audio channels; no transitions). The answer carries the whole file in `inhalt` and a file name — write it to disk for the person. Media are referenced by their FilmLab URLs: in Resolve, File > Import > Timeline, then relink offline clips by file name.

format.description: fcpxml for Resolve/Final Cut (carries transitions), otio for OpenTimelineIO tools, edl as the lowest common denominator

seq_id.description: Sequence id (from lab_list_sequences/lab_get_sequence) — positive integer as string
